issues.description: The review says '17 runs that wrote a report (16 in the generator comparison plus loop-001)', and repeats it as 'None of the 17 reporting runs improved'. Only 10 of the 16 comparison runs wrote a report. data/results/generator_comparison.json has an audit result for deepseek-2, glm-2/3/4, glm-sonnet-2/3/4 and sonnet-2/3/4. The 6 others (deepseek-3/4, mimo-2/3/4, mimo-big-3) ended with 'no selected idea produced a valid run' and no write-up. The correct figure is 11 reports including loop-001. '0 of the 16 comparison runs' in the comparison section is also trivially true for the 6 runs with no valid experiment. The 'no improvement' finding is weaker than stated, and docs/04 T9 says 'all 16 runs' in the same way.

docs/07 already marks Increment 2 'complete 2026-10-02' and Increment 3 '← CURRENT'. CONTRACT.md line 34 says 'Current increment: Increment 3' and 'Only Increment 3 work is in scope'. The gate-state.json approvals contain no incr2_review, and the review itself says to 'keep incr3_scoped for Chris's approval'. The review does not disclose that these files were changed ahead of the human approval. That is the one honesty point the review was meant to cover here.

The 'Independent Evaluator' section says findings and how they were addressed 'are listed here after each round', but nothing is listed. docs/04 T7 records that a round-1 Evaluator finding already changed the input-token table (summed the discarded -1 runs; GLM 13,017 became 10,326, Sonnet 15% became 14%). That round-1 finding is not recorded in the review. The SPEC acceptance requires every verdict kept and the review to pass fresh rounds.

The review says check_dogfood.py 'now enforces it at incr3_review'. gates.yaml has no incr3_review gate. The script defaults to --since-gate incr1_review. Enforcement at incr3_review would need a gate definition and a --since-gate incr2_review argument. The claim is unsupported. The gates.yaml comment at lines 235-239 is also stale: it says 'Only the scope gate is defined so far', but every Increment 2 gate is now defined.

T6, T7 and T9 are headed 'decided 2026-10-01' and say '(Chris, 2026-10-01, by approving trades_decided_2...)'. gate-state.json and telemetry show trades_decided_2 approved 2026-10-02T10:40:59Z (the 10-01 23:51 event was a gate_blocked). The dates are wrong. T9 says 'about 100 times less' than the estimate, while the review and R10 say about 110 (5.7/0.052 = 109.6). T1 and docs/02 JDG-P-01 carry no record of the 97.4% re-test, although docs/02 v0.4 says measurements were recorded beside AUD-P-01 and AUD-P-02.

The 'idea_worth_run' paragraph says 84 verdicts exist and 'the re-test excludes them'. data/retest/split.json coverage shows 77 records excluded for 'no shadow answer' in the 26 runs used. 84 is the count across all 30 gates.jsonl files, so the two numbers are not reconciled. The sentence 'Keep effort: minimal out of the judge's re-test baseline: re-test the judge at the loop's configuration' is self-contradictory as worded. The two confident perturbed misses (retest-0008, retest-0038) are unexamined, so a mislabelled item is not ruled out. The review says so.

The cost comparison uses the comparison-run costs (A $0.0019, B $0.0172, E $0.0492), which start from the recorded smoke-007 baseline and so exclude the baseline stage and sandbox time. This is not stated. The $0.0524 loop-001 figure is complete. The 'about 110 times' ratio compares the complete run with the estimate, and the GLM and mixed rows are not like-for-like.

notes: GAPS: 1) '17 reporting runs' is wrong; the correct figure is 11 (10 comparison runs with audits plus loop-001), so the headline 'no run beat baseline' rests on fewer runs than claimed. 2) The review does not say docs/07 and CONTRACT.md were updated before approval. 3) The Evaluator section lists no round findings, though round 1 demonstrably altered docs/04 T7. 4) The incr3_review enforcement claim has no gate behind it, and the gates.yaml comment is stale. 5) T6/T7/T9 decision dates are wrong (10-01 vs 10-02), and T9's '100x' disagrees with '110x'. 6) The 84 vs 77 idea_worth_run counts are not reconciled. 7) The review does not state that the comparison costs exclude the baseline stage. 8) Wall-time, Docker-reliability and OpenRouter-billing claims are properly hedged. Dogfood and the missing per-session logging are honestly flagged. R10 text matches the review. T4 and T5 numbers match docs/04. SPEC caps $3/$4/$1/$3/$11 match. ECTS-HFD inventory row (0.0-0.5% vs 1-4%) matches. SPEC Increment 2 review list items are all addressed, with open items restated.
